card.name: Points where 'whom' or 'anyone' comes next
card.fires_on: Words just before an expected 'whomever', 'whom' or 'anyone', such as 'with', 'to' or 'than' after a verb like associate, sell or know better. Also the start 'Wh' of 'Wholesalers'.

modes.label: Before whomever/anyone
modes.description: A preposition or comparison word after which 'whomever' or 'anyone' is likely to follow.
modes.example: Every person is allowed to speak to and associate<< with>> whomever they choose.

modes.label: Start of Wh- words
modes.description: The opening 'Wh' of a word such as whomever or Wholesalers.
modes.example: Every person is allowed to speak to and associate with<< wh>>omever they choose.

modes.label: Rhetorical 'anyone?'
modes.description: A comma before a tag-question 'anyone?' in casual writing.

card.writes: It pushes toward words beginning with wh- or qu- and away from 'anyone' and 'whoever' forms.
card.plain: It fires where the next word is likely 'whomever' or 'anyone', and it favors wh- words over those.
